# Vienna stuffings

Personal patches on top of upstream Vienna, kept on the `perso` branch.

## Patches so far:

- **Show media:thumbnail at top of articles (YouTube feeds)** — Vienna didn't display the video 
  thumbnail provided by YouTube feeds; it's now shown above the article text. 
- **Allow hiding the preview pane in vertical layout too** — upstream only allowed it in
  horizontal layout.
- **Unread titles in accent color, read titles dimmed** — read/unread visible at a glance; the
  bold setting now applies to all articles. i like bold.. what can i say..
- **Remove single-key shortcuts** — every shortcut uses a modifier key, like standard macOS apps;
  arrows expand/collapse folders, Tab cycles panes, an article always stays selected.
- **Menu shortcuts** — ⌘U toggles read/unread, ⇧⌘U next unread,
  ⌥⌘U first unread, ⌘O opens the article.
